metadata.description: Store-listing screenshot maker for Claude Code: headline, device frame and one background that runs through the whole row.

plugins.name: store-screenshots
plugins.description: Turns raw app screenshots into App Store and Google Play listing images in the style of the big food and ride apps: a flat brand colour, a short headline, the phone bleeding off the bottom, dishes or shapes and a line running through the whole row. Zero dependencies (Node + Chrome).
